mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in the S&P 500 as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), wage pressures intensify, leading to higher corporate costs and inflation, which triggers a sell-off in equities as the Federal Reserve delays rate cuts, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when the labor market tightness condition is met, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and corporate profitability, which supports higher equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.5% year-over-year, it signals strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% YoY, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), the Federal Reserve is compelled to maintain restrictive monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a contraction in the broader economy, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in the equity market, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
